title: Magpie BBQ Swoop
style: Tasmanian novelty electro-pop with bouncy half-time groove, beatboxed percussion, cheeky phonk bass, and clap-packed hook; verse rotates Corey, Michelle, Ruby, and Wesley, pre-chorus strips to handclaps and harmony stacks, chorus hits with gang vocals and Spanish licks. Ad-libbed doubles, kid-call echoes, delay throws, glockenspiel chirps, vinyl skids. Bright, punchy, cartoon-bright mix., comedy, oi
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Corey: Corey A I eye, eye sees all
Hawk eye in the sky, I clock your call
Super intelligence, back to front
Reverse-engineer the whole damn stunt

Michelle: Pink drink thinks, “pink milk drink”
I suss that swirl in a second, I think
Micha, wezza, bo bo, aye i i
We laugh so hard that the gulls all cry

Ruby: Pelican is what we reckon
Quokka, otter, galah, no second guessin’
I’m little but sharp, aye, watch me grin
Sneaky little plan in a jelly tin

Wesley: I’m Wesley, mate, with a grin so sly
Mi mini black sniffer poodle by my side
Aussie, aussie, aussie, here aha here
We make that chaos disappear

[Pre-Chorus]
Corey: Oi, what’s that shadow?
Michelle: Oi, it’s a swoop, mate
Ruby: Hold your plate, hold your plate
Wesley: Too late, too late

All: Aye, aye, aye, we run
Aye, aye, aye, we duck

[Chorus]
Aussie aussie aussie
Here aha here
Aussie aussie aussie
We all appear

Magpie swoop!
Save the BBQ plate
Magpie swoop!
Too late, too late

Aussie aussie aussie
Oi oi oi
Aussie aussie aussie
That’s our noise

[Verse 2]
Corey: I see the map before it lands
Hawk eye logic in my little hands
If a magpie circles, I know the score
I’m one step back and two steps more

Michelle: I bring the pink cup, cold and sweet
Spanish lick on top, “muy bien, ché!”
Then I go, “¿Qué pasa?” with a wink
While the whole back porch goes, “pink milk drink!”

Ruby: I’ve got a comic-book kind of brain
If the pelican’s grumpy, I don’t complain
I talk to the quokka, I chat to the cat
And the galah says, “mate, imagine that!”

Wesley: My black sniffer poodle, tiny boss
Tracks the snag smoke right across the grass
When the swoop hits hard, I go full save
And I guard that sausage like a brave little wave

[Bridge]
[Beatbox Break]
Corey: Boom-bap, swoop-swoop, I’m on watch
Michelle: Ay, ay, qué bonito, what a shot
Ruby: Weza, bo bo, do the dodge
Wesley: Oi, oi, oi, then snack in the lodge

All: Pelican is what we reckon
Quokka, otter, galah, checkin’
Aussie, aussie, aussie, here aha here
We come back loud with zero fear

[Chorus]
Aussie aussie aussie
Here aha here
Aussie aussie aussie
We all appear

Magpie swoop!
Save the BBQ plate
Magpie swoop!
Too late, too late

Aussie aussie aussie
Oi
